subject: Milestone-based invoice split & early-remit onboarding proposal
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena@novacorp.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: proposed milestone invoicing + early remit for first two sprints

Hi Rohan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Friday. We're excited to get started with Redwood. Before we finalize the SOW, procurement asked whether we can do a milestone-split invoice schedule for the first three deliverables (two smaller sprints and a launch milestone).

Specifically: can NovaCorp submit two smaller invoices (Sprint 1, Sprint 2) within 30 days of milestone completion, and request an accelerated partial payment (50% of each invoice) within 7 business days for cashflow reasons? Full invoice balance would remain payable on Net 45.

Attached is the draft SOW and our vendor setup packet (a quick W‑9 included). We understand accelerated remit is an exception — happy to provide a more formal justification if needed.

Elena Novak
Vendor Ops, NovaCorp
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Novacorp_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), Vendor_W9.pdf (pdf)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: proposed milestone invoicing + early remit for first two sprints

Thanks Elena — appreciate the context and the SOW.

High level: Redwood's standard vendor terms for new suppliers are Net 45 after invoice receipt, with PO routing required for any work scoped in the SOW. Early/accelerated payments are handled on a case-by-case basis and require approval from Finance and Procurement, plus a signed PO that enumerates the milestone schedule.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa (procurement) to confirm PO intake fields we need for milestone splits.
- Kimberly (finance) to review early remit exception and confirm whether a partial 7-business-day pay for up to 50% is acceptable under our controls and what fees (if any) would apply.
- If approved, we will map the milestone invoice lines in the PO and include a short payment addendum in DocuSign.

Can you confirm the exact amounts or percentages for Sprint 1 and Sprint 2 so procurement can size the PO lines? Also flag any tax or vendor classification details we should know.

—Rohan
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Elena Novak <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: proposed milestone invoicing + early remit for first two sprints

On Tue, Apr 26, 2027 at 11:04 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com> wrote:
> High level: Redwood's standard vendor terms for new suppliers are Net 45 after invoice receipt...

Elena / Rohan — quick read from Finance: we can approve a conditional accelerated remit for new vendors on an exception basis up to 50% of an invoice, provided all of the following are satisfied:
- Procurement creates a PO with discrete line items matching each milestone (Sprint 1, Sprint 2, Launch).
- Vendor passes W‑9 and legal verification (we need TIN match and corporate registration).
- Vendor signs the payment addendum in DocuSign that documents the early remit percentage, timing, and recoupment language should work not be accepted on final review.

Notes on fees: we prefer to avoid additional third-party factoring fees — Redwood will not pay external financing fees on vendor side. We can offer the accelerated remit at no fee for the first two onboarding milestones as a one-time onboarding concession, but will not extend that to subsequent invoices without a history of clean deliverables and timely invoice artifacts.

Please share the dollar splits (or percentages) for Sprint 1 and Sprint 2 and I'll run this through final approval. I've attached the vendor setup checklist to procurement's shared drive (link below) — procurement should confirm required PO fields.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/finance/vendor-setup-checklist

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena@novacorp.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: proposed milestone invoicing + early remit for first two sprints

On Tue, Apr 27, 2027 at 08:23 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena / Rohan — quick read from Finance: we can approve a conditional accelerated remit for new vendors on an exception basis up to 50%...

Elena — thanks for the SOW. I've created a PO template with three line items to match the milestones. Per Rohan's ask, please confirm the proposed amounts below so we can lock the PO and DocuSign addendum:

- Sprint 1 (dev work): $24,000 — request 50% accelerated (i.e., $12,000 within 7 business days)
- Sprint 2 (integration): $18,000 — request 50% accelerated (i.e., $9,000 within 7 business days)
- Launch milestone: $43,000 — standard Net 45

If those amounts look correct, I'll:
1) Push the PO to your procurement address for signature and PO acceptance.
2) Kick off DocuSign for the vendor payment addendum (we'll include recoupment language and acceptance gates).
3) Request legal to validate the recoupment clause prior to signature.

Elena — please reply with a one-line confirmation of the amounts and whether NovaCorp accepts the no-fee one-time accelerated remit concession for the two onboarding milestones. Once we have that, procurement and finance will proceed.

—Marissa
Senior Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference
